data.text: Hook runs (UserPromptSubmit output placed before the same natural prompt, 10 Sonnet agents): journal used by 9/10, as the first step by 6; correct 10/10; median context added 7.9k vs 10.9k before (sum 76k vs 103k); median tool calls 3 vs 6.5; median time 25 s vs 44 s; 0 answers from off-git docs/ vs 1-3. The hook pointed at the target record on 7 of 10; on the other three agents still went to kadence first (search or doc show) and got there. Simulated rather than live: a subagent never fires UserPromptSubmit, so the hook's real stdout was prepended to its prompt. Suite: 1175 tests, one 'timed out in 5000ms' per full run, a different prime test each time, load average 9.7; prime.test.ts alone 34/34.
